section.sectionSummaryBrief: The sin of the Tree of Knowledge caused a descent in the entire chain of progression, affecting even the emotions in the World of Creation.
section.t: Now, the sin of the Tree of Knowledge caused a descent in the entire order of the chain of progression,
just as in the first man the sin caused a descent not only in his feet in Asiyah,
so that he felt a physical taste,
but also in his body in Yetzirah,
for the World of Yetzirah is the matter of the emotions,
as Zeir Anpin nests in Yetzirah,
and this means,
that the sin caused a descent also in the emotions of Yetzirah,
so that the emotions as they are after the sin are not similar to the emotions as they were before the sin.
And just as the descent in his feet in Asiyah was through intellect and feeling,
so too the descent in the emotions came through feeling.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The beginning of the emotions is Chesed, which has two levels—revealed and concealed—and the concealment occurs when the intellect shines in the heart, causing the emotions to be nullified.
section.t: And the explanation of the matter is,
that the beginning of the emotions is the matter of Chesed,
and in Chesed there are concealed chassadim and revealed chassadim.
Revealed chassadim are the matter of Chesed as it comes in revelation,
and concealed chassadim are as Chesed is in concealment from the aspect of intellect.
And the intention in concealed chassadim is not for the emotions that are included in the intellect,
for,
when they are included in the intellect they are not emotions of the heart but emotions of the intellect,
and then it is not applicable to distinguish between concealed chassadim and revealed chassadim,
and thus,
the intention in concealed chassadim is for the emotions as they are in their place in the heart,
except that they are nullified from the aspect of the intellect that shines in the heart.
And the matter in this is,
that,
although the emotions come from the intellect,
and as it is stated in Tanya
that Chabad is called the mothers and source for the emotions,
for through contemplating how great are Your works, Hashem,
and how great are Your deeds, Hashem,
the emotions are revealed,
love of Hashem and His awe and fear and to glorify Him, etc.,
and as the Rambam states,
"And how is the way to His love and awe? At the time that one contemplates, etc.,"
that through contemplation appropriate to love, the attribute of love is born,
and through contemplation appropriate to awe, the attribute of awe is born,
nevertheless,
at the time that the intensity of the intellect shines,
it is impossible for there to be an existence of emotions in revelation,
and only at the time that the mochin depart,
when nothing shines,
or the intellect shines in a manner of makif at least,
then there can be an existence of the emotion in revelation.
However,
there is a level in the emotions that even when the intellect is revealed,
and it causes nullification in the emotions,
nevertheless the emotions exist in their reality in the heart.
And this matter is when one contemplates the depth and inwardness of the intellect and understands the intellect not through the vessels of comprehension and grasp,
which are the vessels of the brain,
then the light of the intellect can shine also in the heart.
And this means,
that when the contemplation is only through the vessels of the brain,
then it shines only in the brain and not in the heart,
but when the contemplation is in the inwardness and depth of the intellect above the vessels of the brain,
then there are no limitations of the brain there,
and it can shine also in the heart
(and on the contrary,
their primary existence is in the heart),
and at the time that the intellect shines in the heart, this causes nullification in the emotions,
and this means that the primary thing is the intellect,
and on the contrary,
the inwardness of the intellect,
and nevertheless there is an existence of emotion in the heart,
except that the emotion is not felt,
because it is nullified to the intellect that shines in the heart,
and this is the matter of the inwardness of the emotions.
And now,
from the aspect of the inwardness of the emotions in which the inwardness of the mochin shine,
there cannot be suckling for the external forces,
because the emotions are not noticeable and felt,
but from the aspect of the externality of the mochin from which the externality of the emotions are made,
there can be suckling for the external forces.
And this is the matter of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge,
that the matter of feeling in the emotions was made, so that they are noticeable and felt,
and this is the matter of revealed chassadim.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: In divine service, there is a distinction between "the nearness of G-d is good" (like the Tree of Life) and "the nearness of G-d is good for me" (revealed chassadim), where the latter involves self-awareness and can allow suckling to the other side.
section.t: And the matter in this in the service of Hashem,
that,
there is the matter of "the nearness of G-d is good,"
and there is the matter of "the nearness of G-d is good for me."
"The nearness of G-d is good" means that G-dliness is good in itself,
and from this there is no suckling for the other side.
And this is the matter of the Tree of Life,
about which it is said,
"and eat and live forever,"
that there is no suckling from it for the other side.
But "the nearness of G-d is good for me" is in a manner that it becomes felt,
that he mixes his own existence into it,
to the point that it can be that the primary thing is what he feels of himself,
and G-dliness is only in a secondary way,
and therefore if he does not feel himself,
meaning he does not feel how G-dliness is good for me,
then the love can be nullified,
and this is the matter of revealed chassadim,
which is in the aspect of feeling itself.
And from this there can be suckling for the other side,
and this means,
that although even the feeling of "the nearness of G-d is good for me" is a matter of holiness,
nevertheless,
there can be from it suckling for the other side,
as is known that from the Chesed of Avraham can come the love of the Philistines
(as explained in the matter of the klipah of the Philistines).
And even though also in the aspect of the externality of the mochin
(from which the externality of the emotions are drawn,
revealed chassadim)
there can be protection from the suckling of the other side,
by means of the intellect shining in the manner of makif,
nevertheless,
there is a need for caution and counsel, etc.
(a safeguarding),
but in the inwardness of the mochin,
there is no need for any caution at all regarding this.
